4452-5412-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-5412-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-4742-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4742-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

323-728-1981-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

851-2557-3129-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4038-5963-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two Halflings.
4038-5963-7908.description:
Activate Marvin using The Notary Hobbits' ability by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

2178-4050-7690-7797--165.description:
Activate Agent Phil Coulson by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Hero you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Wall.
When the Wall dies, Agent Phil Coulson triggers, untapping Agent Phil Coulson.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2446-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-6965.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

884-4399-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-4399-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

549-5641-6824-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-5641-6824-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

193-3604-7434.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Brass Infiniscope.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-3604-7434.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.
Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

4186-4384-4716.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4384-4716.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

465-643-3742-4251-4742.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3259-4742-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3480-3899-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1692-2489-2493-3732.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1692-2489-2493-3732.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1692-2489-2493-3732.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

586-3140-7070.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Gix.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Gix.
The Soltari Guerrillas ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3967-5010-5708-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

38-5220-6634-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4871-5231-6476-6927.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4871-5231-6476-6927.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Damage Control Crew and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Damage Control Crew enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Damage Control Crew, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

645-997-1267-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-997-1267-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

1399-1606-2957-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 4.
1399-1606-2957-4249.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to your devotion to green.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

826-851-4508-5880.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

573-654-4572-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-654-4572-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Gruul Turf.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

2082-4186-6798.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Scurry Oak.
2082-4186-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2082-4186-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-539-4188--111.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
478-539-4188--111.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

560-2511-4550-4616.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2511-4550-4616.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Moldervine Reclamation triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards and gain 2 life.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Repeat.

1061-1409-1576.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U} the first turn, with {4}{U}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1409-1576.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Forerunner of the Coalition.
1061-1409-1576.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Forerunner of the Coalition using its ability from Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability and Deadeye Navgiator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Forerunner of the Coalition's ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, pairing it with Forerunner of the Coalition.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5231-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-5231-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Lazotep Convert, adding {R}.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Repeat from step 4.

3168-4452-4518-5613.notablePrerequisites: "Samurai" chosen with Urza's Incubator and Rukarumel.
3168-4452-4518-5613.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3895-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Diregraf Horde, adding {C}{C}.
Diregraf Horde dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Diregraf Horde from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Diregraf Horde enters the battlefield, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1636-1785-3054.notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
You have gained life this turn.
1636-1785-3054.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Oathsworn Vampire enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

4091-4235-5116.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
4091-4235-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability and choose a new target for the copy.
Resolve both copies of Aphetto Alchemist's ability, untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any artifact or creature instead of Gilded Lotus in step 4.
